title: Layout migration
description: Inspect, plan, approve, apply, and verify a guided .specdev layout migration.

inventory.purpose: Inventory the current .specdev layout without modifying it.
inventory.instructions: Run `specdev migrate`, follow the installed layout-migration skill, and submit the inventory path plus a summary of legacy or ambiguous content.

plan.purpose: Write a migration plan with proposed moves and open questions.
plan.instructions: Write `.specdev/migration/layout-plan.md`. Do not move, rename, overwrite, or delete files yet. Submit the plan path and a concise summary.

approval.purpose: Obtain explicit user approval before changing the layout.

apply.purpose: Apply only the user-approved filesystem changes.
apply.instructions: Apply the approved plan conservatively. Submit the changed paths and confirm that no unapproved path was modified.

verify.purpose: Verify the migrated project and document remaining issues.
verify.instructions: Run `specdev status --json`, inspect the resulting layout, and submit whether verification passed plus any warnings.

cancelled.purpose: Layout migration was cancelled without applying changes.

done.purpose: Layout migration is complete and verified.
